newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds sees mainly hand-to-mouth trade.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds sees mainly hand-to-mouth trade.

text.p: Trading on the U.K. meals and feeds market was mainly hand-to-mouth on Wednesday where business was reported.
"There is no forward buying going on any where," said a trader.
The only trade reported was for spot Brazilian 48 percent protein soymeal which fetched 198.50 stg for spot ex-store Teignmouth.
During the morning sellers came out with high protein soymeal offers which were around two to three stg above Tuesday's levels. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
